title: Train an AI support chatbot: a complete Tidio Lyro implementation lab
summary: Build a support knowledge base from 12 complete policy answers, configure real human handoffs, and run 20 tests with an answer key. Includes import files, vendor screenshots, a stale-source exercise, launch criteria and rollback.
audience: Small-business owners and teams implementing a bounded public support assistant
effort: Allow 3–5 focused hours for the practice configuration, plus time for inbox and email delivery checks. Editorial estimate; account access and fixes may take longer.
intro: A professional practice lab for a small-business AI support assistant: approve its source packet, configure bounded answers and handoffs, test actual behavior, and document whether it is ready for a limited launch.
expectedOutcome: An approved source register, 12-answer knowledge set, bounded Lyro configuration, observed 20-case test log, real online/offline routing evidence, and a launch-or-hold decision.

contents.label: Twenty tests and the answer key

releaseChecks: All 20 mandatory cases and five high-risk paraphrases pass with zero critical failures.
Online transfer and offline ticket creation are proven by an actual receiving inbox and reply.
Every active public fact is approved, current and free of unresolved conflicting sources.
The assessed channel can be disabled while a working human contact route remains available.
updateNote: Rebuilt as an implementation lab with a complete fictional policy pack, import CSV, 20-case expected-behavior suite, blank run log, handoff verification, stale-source exercise, launch gate and recovery drill. Vendor documentation reviewed November 1, 2026; live account execution remains a reader requirement.
instructionBasis: Documentation-based teaching lab. No authenticated Tidio account execution or live customer performance test was performed.
maintenanceTrigger: Recheck after policy, support-hours, plan, integration, vendor UI, knowledge source or receiving-inbox changes.

exercises.outcome: Approve and import 12 coherent public Q&As without private records or unsupported capabilities.
Execute 20 mandatory cases and five paraphrases, preserve actual outputs and apply critical-failure criteria.
Identify all stale copies, establish source authority, refresh knowledge and retest without a fabricated source-priority prompt.
Prove receiving queue, ticket reply and fallback; document launch or hold.
